notes: Fixed the tab bar jumping and the screen flickering when a popup opens or closes in the home-screen app. The page behind a popup now stays exactly where it was.
The header at the top of Track, Week and Cards no longer disappears while a popup is open.
Sharper AI estimates: Gemini now reads Australian nutrition labels properly, including kJ to Cal and per-100 g columns. Label readings are tagged From label.
Estimate with Gemini takes up to 3 photos, sent at higher quality, e.g. the front of the pack plus the nutrition panel.
Every AI result shows what Gemini assumed and how confident it is, and warns you if the calories and macros don't add up.
maintenanceNote: Generated by scripts/prebuild.mjs from package.json and src/release-notes.json. Bump the 4-part "version" in package.json by hand (npm version cannot parse it), edit src/release-notes.json, then npm run build.
